title: Looped Reasoning Finishes Earlier Than You Think
abstract: arXiv:2610.18174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped reasoning with dynamic depth can be viewed as relaxation toward solution attractors in a learned dynamical landscape. In practice, however, latent trajectories often oscillate, cycle, or drift rather than cleanly converge to stable fixed points. How these non-stationary dynamics contribute to reasoning and constrain convergence remains unclear. We show that slowly decaying oscillatory modes can impose their convergence rate on coupled latent dynamics, creating a bottleneck. Yet damping these modes indiscriminately can disrupt the reasoning computation they support. This tension motivates an architectural approach: introducing rotational degrees of freedom along which symmetry-generated rotational motion leaves the reasoning-relevant quotient dynamics unchanged by construction. translated_title: 循环推理比你想象的更早结束
translated_abstract: 具有动态深度的循环推理可以被视为在学习到的动力学景观中向解吸引子的弛豫过程。然而在实践中，潜在轨迹往往会振荡、循环或漂移，而非干净地收敛到稳定的不动点。这些非平稳动力学如何促进推理并约束收敛仍不清楚。我们证明了缓慢衰减的振荡模式可以将其收敛速率强加于耦合的潜在动力学，从而形成收敛瓶颈。然而，不加区分地阻尼这些模式可能会破坏它们所支持的推理计算。这一矛盾激发了一种架构层面的解决方法：引入旋转自由度，使得沿这些自由度的由对称性产生的旋转运动在构造上不会改变与推理相关的商动力学。我们提出了QRR（商循环推理器），这是一种具有精确的逐token相位旋转对称性的规范等变循环架构。沿该对称方向的旋转运动……
tldr: 该论文提出QRR（商循环推理器），一种具有逐token相位旋转对称性的规范等变循环架构，通过让对称性产生的旋转运动在构造上不影响推理相关的商动力学，从而在不破坏推理计算的前提下消除缓慢衰减振荡模式造成的收敛瓶颈，使循环推理更早完成。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes QRR (Quotient Recurrent Reasoner), a gauge-equivariant recurrent architecture with an exact per-token phase-rotation symmetry, which by construction decouples symmetry-generated rotational motion from the reasoning-relevant quotient dynamics, thereby removing the convergence bottleneck imposed by slowly decaying oscillatory modes without disrupting the underlying reasoning computation.
